topic: Duty to the Administration of Justice

questions.q: Following a ruling against their client at the WSIB, a paralegal posts on their public social media account that the adjudicator was "a corrupt idiot who takes bribes." The paralegal has no evidence to support this claim. What ethical duty has the paralegal breached?
options: The duty to maintain client confidentiality.
The duty to encourage public respect for the administration of justice.
The duty to communicate promptly with the tribunal.
The duty to avoid conflicts of interest.
questions.explain: Rule 2.01 mandates that a paralegal shall encourage public respect for, and try to improve, the administration of justice. Making baseless, highly derogatory, and public allegations of corruption against a tribunal adjudicator violates this duty.
